meta.title: Turtle Season Intelligence AI
meta.historicalSource: LAST SEASONES ORDERING & SALE THRU DATA.xlsb
meta.upcomingSource: SEG WISE SS27 MASTER SHEET TILL.xlsb
meta.imageMappingStatus: Preview mapped 200 of 200 sampled upcoming images; full SS27 catalogue coverage is 5550 of 5550.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Identifiers
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: Identifiers locate products but do not describe reusable product similarity.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Colour variant code
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: Variant codes are identifiers; colour names are used for similarity.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Season
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: Season supports tracing and temporal validation but is outside the five approved product attributes.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Demand outcomes
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: Historical outcomes train and validate demand; they cannot be product-similarity inputs.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Commercial operations
excludedNonComparisonFields.historicalColumn: max_quantity, pt_quantity, ril_quantity, first_dispatch_date, ageing_days, weekly_sell_through
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: These fields have no like-for-like counterpart in the other workbook.

meta.previewSamplingMethod: Deterministic balanced stratification by itemType, then categoryType
meta.visualMethod: Visual-only FashionSigLIP retrieval with multi-scale DINO, dominant-palette CIEDE2000 colour gating and texture reranking

patternGate.scope: all visually retrieved candidates except OTTR; OTTR hard-gates only CHECKS, PRINTS, STRIPES and DOBBY/STRUCTURE
patternGate.policy: exclude candidate when the body-pattern distance exceeds the limit

colourDescriptor.distance: symmetric weighted palette ΔE plus dominant-colour ΔE
colourDescriptor.region: central garment body with studio-background suppression

colourGate.policy: exclude candidate when garment-palette perceptual ΔE exceeds the limit

model.algorithm: FashionSigLIP retrieval + multi-scale DINO, dominant-palette CIEDE2000 colour and pattern gates + texture reranking
model.salesPolicy: Similarity-weighted, censoring-corrected demand pooled across accepted analogues and shrunk toward the item-type/category prior
model.orderPolicy: Newsvendor buy whose expected sell-through equals the planner target under the predicted demand distribution
model.noMatchPolicy: Return no product match, zero system quantity and manual review when the single best candidate lacks visual evidence or falls below the threshold.

visionCalibration.method: Separate robust logistic calibration for FashionSigLIP, multi-scale DINOv2, dominant-palette CIEDE2000 colour and texture candidate distances; component weights are configured explicitly
